Coerce an inferential comparison to a network difference

Source: R/subtract_networks.R
as_netdifference.Rd

as_netdifference() turns the result of a network comparison into a plain netdifference object, the signed difference network that subtract_networks() returns, so that cograph's difference renderer draws it. It reads a bayes_compare() result (net_bayes), and returns a netdifference unchanged. The drawn weights are the posterior mean differences, by default only those of the credible edges, while the full difference, its credible intervals and its probabilities of direction are kept beside them.

Usage

as_netdifference(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'net_bayes'
as_netdifference(x, significant_only = TRUE, ...)

# S3 method for class 'netdifference'
as_netdifference(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
as_netdifference(x, ...)

Arguments

x

The comparison: a net_bayes from bayes_compare(), or a netdifference, which is returned as it is. Any other object raises an error.

...

Not used.

significant_only

For a net_bayes: whether the drawn weights keep only the credible differences (those bayes_compare() marks in sig), with every other edge set to 0. The full difference and interval matrices are kept either way. Default TRUE.

Value

A netdifference object, which is also a netobject (method "difference"); print() lists its edges and cograph::splot() draws it. From a net_bayes, its weights are the posterior mean differences (all of them, or only the credible ones, by significant_only), and it keeps the full posterior mean difference (difference_matrix), the two posterior mean matrices (x, y), the interval bounds (ci_lower, ci_upper), the Bayesian p-equivalents (p_values), the probabilities of direction (p_difference), the credibility matrix (sig), significant_only, and netdifference_type = "bayes_compare".

Examples

s1 <- data.frame(V1 = c("A", "B", "C"), V2 = c("B", "C", "A"))
s2 <- data.frame(V1 = c("A", "C", "B"), V2 = c("C", "B", "A"))
b <- bayes_compare(build_network(s1, method = "relative"),
                   build_network(s2, method = "relative"),
                   draws = 500, seed = 1)
as_netdifference(b, significant_only = FALSE)
#> Network difference (x - y): 3 nodes, 6 differing edges
#> Plot: cograph::splot(d) or cograph::plot_difference(d)
#> 
#>  from to   x   y difference
#>     B  A 0.2 0.6       -0.4
#>     C  A 0.6 0.2        0.4
#>     A  B 0.6 0.2        0.4
#>     C  B 0.2 0.6       -0.4
#>     A  C 0.2 0.6       -0.4
#>     B  C 0.6 0.2        0.4
#>     A  A 0.2 0.2        0.0
#>     B  B 0.2 0.2        0.0
#>     C  C 0.2 0.2        0.0
